title: Freelance Time Tracker
description: Track billable time per client and project: start/stop timer, automatic log saved in your browser, per-client totals and CSV export for invoicing.
howto: Type the client and project, then press Start — the timer runs live.
Press Stop to log the session with its exact duration.
Review the log below: edit nothing, delete mistakes, see per-client totals.
Export CSV when it is time to invoice.

faqs.q: Where are my time entries stored?
faqs.a: In your browser's localStorage, namespaced to this tool. They persist across reloads on the same device and browser.

faqs.q: What if I close the tab mid-session?
faqs.a: The start timestamp is saved immediately, so reopening the tool resumes the running timer from the original start time.
Yes — the manual entry form adds a session for a past date and duration, e.g. for work done offline.
